1: As it is said: (Numbers 14:6) "And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, of those who had scouted the land, rent their clothes". I may hear, the first in the account is the first in importance; but it is also said (Numbers 32:12) "none except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun", from this we learn that they are both equal.
